name: Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Official admission letter from an approved Nigerian educational institution.
Proof of financial support for the duration of study.

outcome.duration_length: duration of academic program, typically 1 year, renewable subject to continued enrollment

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS) -- Student Visa: full-time studies at approved Nigerian institutions, requires official admission letter, financial support proof, medical insurance (where applicable), accommodation evidence; renewal depends on academic progress; students prohibited from paid employment unless specifically authorized

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Nigeria). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 NIS sourced, though the source page is thin beyond the core requirements listed (no fee figures, no explicit CERPAC cross-reference). Students staying 1+ year are also expected to obtain CERPAC (see ng_work_permit.json notes for CERPAC fee structure -- students pay a reduced USD 600 CERPAC fee per e-CERPAC portal figures). No explicit post-study work-visa conversion pathway found; switchable_to ng_work_permit reflects the general possibility of a subsequent employer-sponsored application, not a dedicated graduate-route mechanism.
